title: Tuono V4 Factory 1100 (Sport Black)
description: The Aprilia Tuono V4 Factory 1100 (Sport Black) is crafted for flickable urban agility and stoplight-to-stoplight punch, positioned in the Hyper Naked Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1100cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
